title: Become the answer, not just a result.
subtitle: See how AI search engines understand your restaurant and what to improve to increase its chances of being recommended.
lastAnalysis: Analysis based on current MesaLink data
scoreLow: There is plenty of potential to unlock
scoreMedium: A good base with clear opportunities
opportunitiesSubtitle: Prioritized by their likely impact on how AI systems understand and recommend the restaurant.
queriesTitle: The questions where you want to appear
queriesSubtitle: MesaLink prepares the digital signals needed to associate the restaurant with its cuisine, location and specialties.
howItWorksText: The score combines business, website, menu and review data with live AI-engine measurements. Growth Engine turns the diagnosis into published improvements and records the evolution.
nextPhaseText: Monitor real prompts and execute improvements automatically through the Website Builder, content, local pages, structured data and review management.

growthEngine.title: Growth Engine active
growthEngine.text: AI turns the diagnosis into a complete website: it improves local content, SEO, FAQs, structured data, the AI feed and missing menu descriptions.
growthEngine.confirmText: MesaLink will complete and publish the Website Builder using verified restaurant data. Existing content is preserved where appropriate and contact details are never invented.
growthEngine.successDetail: {fields} elements completed and {dishes} dishes improved. Refreshing the diagnosis…
growthEngine.error: The improvements could not be applied.

liveScan.title: External web-search audit
liveScan.description: Tests high-intent local questions, records whether the restaurant appears, who appears instead and which sources support the answer. This is an API web-search measurement, not a guarantee for every ChatGPT session.
liveScan.emptyText: Run the first audit to compare prompts, competitors and cited sources.

publishWebsite.title: Publish the restaurant website
publishWebsite.text: An accessible website creates an owned source that AI systems can understand and cite.

defineCuisine.title: Clearly define cuisine and specialties
defineCuisine.text: Connect the restaurant to the words guests use, including cuisine, dishes and experience.

structureMenu.title: Structure the menu in MesaLink
structureMenu.text: Readable categories and dishes help answer specific questions about what and where to eat.

describeDishes.title: Add dish descriptions
describeDishes.text: Include ingredients, techniques, specialties and dietary options to create semantic context.

seoMetadata.title: Complete the SEO title and description
seoMetadata.text: Explain briefly what makes the restaurant relevant and where it is located.

businessDetails.title: Complete essential business details
businessDetails.text: A consistent address and phone number strengthen confidence in the restaurant's identity and location.

domainAuthority.title: Connect and verify a custom domain
domainAuthority.text: A stable domain strengthens the authority of the restaurant's official source.

collectReviews.title: Grow the volume of reviews
collectReviews.text: Recent, consistent reviews provide external evidence about quality, dishes and experience.

googleProfile.title: Google Business connected to MesaLink
googleProfile.text: The review flow is ready to strengthen the restaurant's presence and reputation.

aiReadyWebsite.title: Website has a solid AI foundation
aiReadyWebsite.text: The core content is published and structured enough to be understood.
